Made In Oregon: Where do the text badges pull the discount information / percent from? If we are using an automatically applied discount and not changing prouct price/compare at price will it still work?

  Felicie: Hi, it's Felicie from the DECO team!

  Felicie: Ah, about the discount and compare at price you are asking, we are taking the information from the Product part in Shopify, where you have set the discount and compare at price

Made In Oregon: We aren't able to do that since sale is not on POS, online only. So what would you recommend if we need to display 3 different types of badges for our automatic discount, is there an option better than just generic "Sale" badge?

  Felicie: Since automatic discounts don’t update the product price or compare-at price in Shopify, the badge won’t be able to dynamically calculate the exact discount percentage.

  Felicie: However, as a workaround, you could:
* Create **custom/manual badges** (e.g. “-18%”, “-20%”, “Bundle Deal”)
* Then assign them to specific products or collections that match each promotion

  Felicie: This way, you can still display different types of badges instead of a generic “Sale” badge, even though they won’t be calculated automatically.

Made In Oregon: What dimension for creating our own image badge?

  Felicie: There isn’t a strict required dimension for image badges. In most cases, images will be automatically optimized and scaled, so you can upload your design and it should display properly.

  Felicie: Additionally, you can adjust the badge size directly in the app (as shown in the display tab), so the final display will depend on how you configure it there.
